run_train_cifar10: run the CIFAR-10 NAS training loop with DARTS architecture for 600 epochs using SGD optimizer
run_train_with_ema: run the CIFAR-10 training with model EMA tracking and cosine annealing learning rate scheduler
run_train_resume: run the CIFAR-10 training resuming from a saved checkpoint model.pt file
run_train_with_cutmix: run the CIFAR-10 training with CutMix data augmentation and CutMixCrossEntropyLoss criterion
run_infer_validate: run the validation inference loop on the CIFAR-10 test set and report top1 and top5 accuracy
